item.title: Re: (Awaiting greenlight) The Shape-shifting toy
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Alpha_Warhead. Let’s take a look at your concept.

Unfortunately, this sounds like your basic B-movie slasher horror flick which has dolls come alive and try to murder you. I don’t see anything original / unique about the concept, and would highly recommend you try and pick something else that distinguishes your scp from countless others already on the site.

Another way to distinguish your scp would be through a unique narrative, but again, you don’t offer much in the concept pitch besides having a dangerous tongue as weapon, some brown goo effect and the location of an Israeli toy factory. If you really feel your concept is unique / has merit, why don’t you try explaining a bit more what these attributes have in common? Tell us what makes your killer toy unique compared to all the others we’ve seen before?

If my idea gets accepted I will add more to the SCP.

You’ve got the order of this wrong. You should give us the origins and its narrative first in order to get the concept accepted. If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. Best of luck!

item.title: (Awaiting greenlight) The Shape-shifting toy
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Other: Mystery, Discovery

Page Layout (Optional): I plan to explain about the SCP through Addendums incidents logs and autopsy's this will reveal to to the reader what the SCP can do, the affects of it's powers, and it's origin.

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is a spirit that haunts an abandoned factory. It takes form of diffrent toys that the factory used to make but only the toys. The SCP has psychic abilities that affect anyone in a 500 meter distance. It kills humans that pick it up with what looks like a tongue and leaves a brown goo inside of their slashed up bodies after doing so. In the article researchers are trying to find it's origins and more of it's abilities.

Central Narrative: The SCP is found in an abandoned factory in a city in israel. it was due to be destroyed but before being destroyed construction workers were told to inspect the area. Once they entered and saw the spirit SCP one of them decided to take a look. The SCP slashed one of the workers the other one managed to escape. After that incident the foundation was alerted and bought the factory. It set up a site to contain the spirit SCP which could not be moved from the factory. An interview was conducted with the surviving worker after the interview he was given amnestics. An autopsy was conducted and a brown goo-ish substance was left behind test results show it is unknown to the foundation yet. It was found that the goo melts all organs. But not bones. In the article the previous incidents and tests will be found explaining further about the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The attention-grabber here is the spirit SCP. Due to it's unique abilities readers would get interested and read more. For example: The spirit SCP has psychic powers in a 500 meter radius. In the article affects of long exposure to these psychic powers will be explained through incidents and addendums. It's ability to slash humans in half perfectly will also be tested in the article, as well as the goo it leaves behind. It's mystery and discovery will encourage readers to continue to read.

Additional Notes: If my idea gets accepted I will add more to the SCP. It's origins, and solving most of the mysteries still around it. And again this is just an idea not a full SCP. Thanks for reading
